# One green block removed. Need to remove all 13 remaining.
# Then figure out how to move character up.

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] > 5]
print(f"Green blocks remaining: {len(green_nodes)}")

# Click all remaining green blocks
clicks = []
for gn in green_nodes:
    b = gn['boundary']
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in b) // len(b)
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in b) // len(b)
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})

result = action(clicks)

# Check state

blue_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S']

print(f"After removing all: blue regions={len(blue_nodes)}, green blocks={len(green_nodes)}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")

# Check ascii for passage
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nBarrier region (rows 25-37):")
for i in range(25, 38):
    row = ascii_lines[i]
    segment = row[13:54]
    print(f"Row {i}: {segment}")

# Now try to move character up by clicking in the passage
# Try clicking at row 30 (gap between green block rows), col 20
if not last_action_result.get('game_over'):
    print("\nTrying to move character up...")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 30, 'col': 20}])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    char_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10]
    if char_nodes:
        char = char_nodes[0]
        char_pos = char['boundary']
        char_r = sum(p[0] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
        char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
        print(f"Char at ({char_r}, {char_c})")
    else:
        print("Character not found!")
    print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
</parameter>
</function>
